title: Orbit Room: A Solar-System Explorer
description: A self-contained, responsive Three.js planetary explorer with animated stylized orbits, planet selection and field notes, orbit/zoom controls, pause/resume, simulation speed, reset, keyboard shortcuts, and a readable WebGL fallback.

tests.command: node --input-type=module -e "import { build } from 'vite'; await build({ root: process.cwd(), configFile: false, logLevel: 'info', build: { write: false, minify: false } });"
tests.outcome: Passed with Vite 7.3.6; 7 modules transformed and the production bundle completed successfully with write:false.

repairsMade: Removed a no-op empty CSS @import before final syntax and bundle checks to avoid any implication of an external resource.
knownLimitations: Browser localhost access was unavailable, so browser rendering and interaction smoke tests were not run.
Orbital motion, orbit spacing, and planet sizes are intentionally stylized; the interface labels the scene as not to scale.
The WebGL fallback keeps the field guide readable but does not animate a 2D simulation.
